headline: Meta adds real-time voice and video chat to Muse AI avatar
summary: Meta rolled out real-time voice and video chat with its Muse AI avatar, announced by CEO Mark Zuckerberg, with TechCrunch reporting the customizable avatar can take video calls ahead of a wearable device launch. The Verge describes it as a voice mode, while TechCrunch frames it as video chat.

claims.statement: Meta added real-time voice and video chat capability to its Muse AI agent.

sources.quote: Muse has a voice mode now
Meta now lets you have voice conversations with your Muse AI agent in real time
Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar

claims.statement: CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced the feature.
The avatar is customizable and the feature precedes a Tamagotchi-like wearable device for Muse.

sources.quote: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

claims.statement: TechCrunch specifies the rollout is for US users.

sources.quote: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar

discrepancies.explanation: The Verge describes the update as a voice mode, while TechCrunch frames it as video chat with an animated avatar.
